## **WSO2 Amplify \- Tracking Platform Requirements**

## **What is WSO2 Amplify**

WSO2 Amplify is an employee advocacy programme that turns our 830+ employees into WSO2’s most powerful voice in the market. Employees share WSO2 product news, customer wins, events and thought leadership through their own LinkedIn networks.

The programme launches on 15 October 2026 with a 90-day pilot. Sharing is authentic and voluntary, and it is rewarded through WSO2 Coins. A group of 15 to 25 Amplify Champions will help kick-start the movement.

This doc explains why we need a tracking platform, what it must do, and what we learned from evaluating external tools, so the Internal Apps team can assess an in-house build.

## **Why we need a platform**

LinkedIn does not let us track engagement for each employee across many posts. It shows who reacted, commented or reposted on a single post, but it gives no running record per person that we could turn into points and coins.

Doing this by hand for 830+ employees would not scale. This is why enterprise employee advocacy platforms exist: they track each employee’s activity, score it and report on it. Those are the platforms we evaluated, and they set the benchmark for an internal build.

## **Our requirements**

The platform must capture each employee’s LinkedIn activity on WSO2 content, score it and credit WSO2 Coins. Requirements are grouped by stage. Must-haves are needed for the pilot; should-haves can follow.

| Stage | The platform should | Used by |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 1\. Publish | Let Marketing and PO register official WSO2 LinkedIn posts, with category and a priority flag | Marketing, PO |
| 1\. Publish | Share new posts to the Amplify Google Chat space automatically | Marketing, PO |
| 2\. Connect | Let each employee link their LinkedIn profile to their WSO2 account through single sign-on | Employees |
| 3\. Track | Record who reacted, commented, reposted or reposted with commentary on each post | System |
| 3\. Track | Let employees submit their own WSO2-related posts for higher-tier points | Employees |
| 4\. Score | Apply points automatically, once per action per post per person | System |
| 4\. Score | Let PO edit point values, correct records and remove invalid activity | PO |
| 5\. Reward | Convert points into WSO2 Coins in the existing Coins programme | System |
| 5\. Reward | Show each employee their points, Coins and activity history | Employees |
| 6\. Celebrate | Show individual and team leaderboards | Everyone |
| 6\. Celebrate | Report participation, reach and points by team, location and post | PO, SLT |

&nbsp;

\*While the initial pilot focuses on LinkedIn, the platform should be designed to support additional social channels in future phases.

### 

### **Amplify actions and points**

| Amplify action | Points |
| :---- | :---- |
| Repost or share of WSO2 content | Lowest tier |
| Repost or share with personal commentary | Mid tier |
| Original employee post with meaningful WSO2 content | Higher tier |
| Original content later amplified by WSO2 or a senior leader | Highest tier |

&nbsp;

Original employee posts do not appear on official WSO2 posts, so we need a separate way to capture them.

## **Platforms evaluated**

We evaluated several enterprise advocacy platforms, with EveryoneSocial and Sharebee as the strongest fits. EveryoneSocial stands out for its Google Chat integration, which matches how WSO2 already communicates. The full evaluation and feedback are in the [Amplify platform evaluation sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1cV19EmIS5kvxHUoUpx2MB9DJNjqr8BLJwmAJVMu5Jxs/edit?usp=sharing).

| Feature | EveryoneSocial | Sharebee |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Google Chat integration** | **Yes.** Posts appear in chosen Chat spaces, and reactions and comments made in Chat flow back into reporting | Not listed |
| **AI assistance** | **Yes.** AI-powered content suggestions for employees | **Yes.** mAIa, an AI assistant that helps write posts, plus a ChatGPT integration |
| Content library | Pre-approved content ready to share | Ready-to-use posts in the company’s tone of voice |
| Employee’s own posts | Supported | Creator tool to write, schedule and publish posts |
| Gamification | Yes | Points and rankings based on activity and impact |
| Analytics | Engagement tracking and reporting | Reach by company, department or individual |
| Mobile app | Yes | Yes |

&nbsp;

\*The Google Chat and AI features are worth matching in an internal build, since they lower the effort for employees to take part.

## 

## **Key Considerations & Open Questions**

The primary operational dependency is securing reliable, per-employee engagement data via LinkedIn APIs. Below are the core scope parameters and technical queries for the Internal Apps team.

> > •          **Scale:** 830+ global employees and 10–30 official posts monthly.

> > •          **Authentication:** Integration with WSO2 SSO.

> > •          **Data Privacy:** Opt-in profile linking capturing only metrics required for scoring.

> > •          **Governance:** Automated duplicate prevention and complete audit logging.

> > •          What LinkedIn engagement data can we reliably access for each employee?

> > •          Can the platform tell plain reposts apart from reposts with commentary?

> > •          Can it integrate with Google Chat, as EveryoneSocial does?

> > •          Can it offer AI help for employees writing their own posts?

> > •          How will points connect to the existing WSO2 Coins programme?

> > •          What is the estimated effort and earliest go-live date?
